response.sql: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as overall_avg_bandwidth, AVG(telescope_count) as overall_avg_count FROM group_stats

assumptions.assumption: "High side of a 4.86 cutoff" means pointaccarc > 4.86 (strictly greater than). AVG() automatically ignores NULL values when calculating average bandwidth usage per group.

alternatives.interpretation: "High side of a 4.86 cutoff" could be interpreted as pointaccarc >= 4.86 (at or above the threshold, inclusive) rather than strictly greater than.
